prompt: What was David Fincher's most recently released feature film when Britney Spears' first feature film was released in the U.S.?
answer: David Fincher’s most recently released feature film at that time was **_Fight Club_ (1999)**. Britney Spears’s first feature film, **_Crossroads_**, was released in the U.S. on **February 15, 2002**, before Fincher’s next film, **_Panic Room_**, opened on March 29, 2002.
